faq.q: How much does Zinda Law Group charge?
faq.a: Zinda Law Group publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Zinda Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Zinda Law Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Zinda Law Group have offices?
faq.a: Zinda Law Group publishes five offices, in Austin, Phoenix, El Paso, San Antonio and Colorado Springs. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Zinda Law Group?
faq.a: Zinda Law Group names 21 attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Zinda Law Group publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Zinda Law Group publishes three case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Zinda Law Group?
faq.a: Zinda Law Group scores 66 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
